title: AIPACK LineageEnvelope
description: AIPACK-SPEC v0.1.1 §11 — LineageEnvelope predicate payload. Records per-component attribution for an assembled artifact.

artifactRef.description: OCI digest ref of the assembled artifact.

assembledBy.description: Actor URN or identity that performed assembly.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of this envelope.

role.description: Slot name in the composition (e.g. baseModel, skills[0]).
